578:   battleLunge(who, cb) {
579:     if (!this.fighters) return
580:     const mesh = who === 'player' ? this.fighters.player : this.fighters.foe
581:     const start = who === 'player' ? this.playerStart : this.foeStart
582:     const dir = who === 'player' ? 1.6 : -1.6
583:     const t0 = performance.now()
584:     const dur = 320
585:     const tick = () => {
586:       const k = (performance.now() - t0) / dur
587:       if (k >= 1) { mesh.position.x = start.x; if (cb) cb(); return }
588:       const e = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k) * Math.PI)
589:       mesh.position.x = start.x + dir * e
590:       mesh.position.z = start.z - (who === 'player' ? 0.8 : 0.8) * e
591:       requestAnimationFrame(tick)

711:     this.ndc.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1

733:   loop() {

779:   updateHabitat(dt) {
780:     const list = [...this.creatures.values()]
781:     for (const entry of list) {
782:       if (!this.habitat.children.includes(entry.root)) continue
783:       entry.pause -= dt
784:       const dx = entry.target.x - entry.root.position.x
785:       const dz = entry.target.z - entry.root.position.z
786:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz)
787:       let moving = 0
788:       if (entry.pause <= 0) {
789:         if (dist < 0.25) {
790:           entry.pause = 2 + Math.random() * 5
791:           const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
792:           const r = 1.5 + Math.random() * 4.8
793:           entry.target.set(Math.cos(a) * r, 0, Math.sin(a) * r)
794:         } else {
795:           moving = 1
796:           const step = Math.min(dist, entry.speed * dt)
797:           entry.root.position.x += (dx / dist) * step
798:           entry.root.position.z += (dz / dist) * step
799:           const want = Math.atan2(dx, dz)
800:           let diff = want - entry.root.rotation.y
801:           while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2
802:           while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2
803:           entry.root.rotation.y += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 4)
804:         }
805:       }
806:       entry.moving += (moving - entry.moving) * Math.min(1, dt * 5)
807:       entry.root.userData.update?.(dt, entry.moving)

814:     // spore drift
815:     this.driftField(this.spores, dt, 0.25)
816:     this.driftField(this.fireflies, dt, 0.6)
817:   }
818: 
819:   updateArena(dt) {
820:     if (!this.fighters) return
821:     this.fighters.player.userData.update?.(dt, 0)
822:     this.fighters.foe.userData.update?.(dt, 0)
823:     this.driftField(this.embers, dt, 0.55)
824:   }
825: 
826:   driftField(points, dt, speed) {
827:     if (!points) return
828:     const arr = points.geometry.attributes.position.array
829:     const seeds = points.userData.seeds
830:     for (let i = 0; i < seeds.length; i++) {
831:       const s = seeds[i]
832:       arr[i * 3 + 1] += s.speed * dt * speed
833:       arr[i * 3] += Math.sin(this.time * 0.5 + s.phase) * dt * 0.12
834:       arr[i * 3 + 2] += Math.cos(this.time * 0.4 + s.phase) * dt * 0.1
835:       if (arr[i * 3 + 1] > 5.8) arr[i * 3 + 1] = 0.1
836:     }
837:     points.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
838:   }
839: 
840:   updateParticles(dt) {
841:     if (!this.burstPoints) return
842:     const st = this.burstState
843:     const pos = this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.array
844:     for (let i = 0; i < st.max; i++) {
845:       if (st.life[i] <= 0) continue
846:       st.life[i] -= dt
847:       if (st.life[i] <= 0) { pos[i * 3] = 9999; continue }
848:       st.vel[i * 3 + 1] -= 6 * dt
849:       pos[i * 3] += st.vel[i * 3] * dt
850:       pos[i * 3 + 1] += st.vel[i * 3 + 1] * dt
851:       pos[i * 3 + 2] += st.vel[i * 3 + 2] * dt
852:     }
853:     this.burstPoints.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
854:   }
855: 
856:   destroy() {
857:     cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf)
858:     this.clearCreatures()
859:     this.renderer.dispose()
860:     this.container.innerHTML = ''
861:   }
862: }

## Objective
- Expand the existing creature-finding game with more selectable body parts inspired by diverse animals, fish, and insects.

## Requirements
- Build or modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

### Completed

- (none)

1. Read `src/app.js`, `src/dna.js`, `src/creature.js`, `src/scene.js`, and `src/style.css` to understand the existing flow.

- User’s exact request: “Add more body part that can be selected when user try to find a creature. Base you self on a variety of animal,fish,insect”

## Objective
- Expand “Helix Forge — Creature Lab” with more selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts, integrated into creature finding and visuals.

## Requirements
- Build or modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the app flow, genome and phenotype system, creature mesh builder, scene integration points, styles, and package scripts.
- Confirmed `src/dna.js` defines selectable traits as genes and `src/creature.js` builds the procedural creature mesh from phenotype values.

### Active
- Add selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body-part options, connecting their genes to creature appearance and selection.
- Build and verify the game, then capture and inspect a current JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add new body-part genes and phenotype values in `src/dna.js`, preserving compatibility with existing saves and breeding.
2. Render those traits in `src/creature.js` and expose selection when discovering a creature in `src/app.js`.
3. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, genome generation, phenotype, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow, UI, and genome dossier.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.

## Important Context
- The game uses Vite and Three.js; existing genome entries are generated from `GENES`, and phenotype traits drive the creature mesh.
- No changes have been made yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand “Helix Forge — Creature Lab” with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts, connected to creature discovery and visuals.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build and verify the game, save a JPEG screenshot at no more than 1280px wide, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected genome/phenotype generation, creature mesh construction, discovery flow, UI, and build scripts.
- Confirmed `src/dna.js` defines genes and phenotype values, while `src/creature.js` builds procedural creature meshes from them.

### Active
- Add selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body-part genes and connect them to creature visuals and discovery.
- Build and verify the game, then capture and inspect a current JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add body-part genes and phenotype values in `src/dna.js`, preserving compatibility with existing saves and breeding.
2. Render those traits in `src/creature.js` and expose selection when discovering a creature in `src/app.js`.
3. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, genome generation, phenotype, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow, UI, and genome dossier.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.

## Important Context
- Existing genomes are generated from `GENES`; phenotype traits drive the creature mesh.
- No changes have been made yet.

246:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]

248:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2

254: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {

257:   for (const gene of GENES) {

259:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
260:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
261:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
262:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
263:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
264:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
265:       mutations.push(gene.key)
266:     }

269:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
270:     }
271:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]

376:       arm.position.set(side * torsoRX * 0.72, torsoRY * 0.52, torsoRZ * 0.18)
377:       arm.rotation.z = side * 0.16
378:       const upper = armLen * 0.54, fore = armLen * 0.48, thick = legThick * 0.68
379:       addMesh(arm, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick, upper, 2, 7), bodyMat, [0, -upper * 0.42, 0])
380:       const elbow = new THREE.Group()
381:       elbow.position.y = -upper * 0.84
382:       arm.add(elbow)
383:       addMesh(elbow, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick * 0.76, fore, 2, 7), darkMat, [0, -fore * 0.42, torsoRZ * 0.025])
384:       addMesh(elbow, new THREE.SphereGeometry(thick * 1.18, 8, 6), darkMat, [0, -fore * 0.86, torsoRZ * 0.04])
385:       for (let c = -1; c <= 1; c++) {
386:         addMesh(elbow, new THREE.ConeGeometry(thick * 0.2, thick * 0.72, 4), clawMat,
387:           [c * thick * 0.54, -fore * 0.9, torsoRZ * 0.16], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0])
388:       }
389:       bodyGroup.add(arm)
390:       arms.push({ group: arm, side })
391:     }
392:   }
393: 
394:   // ── ground fit ──
395:   model.updateMatrixWorld(true)
396:   const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model)
397:   const lift = -box.min.y
398:   model.position.y = lift + 0.015
399: 
400:   // animation state
401:   let t = Math.random() * 10
402:   let walkAmt = 0
403:   let flashTime = 0
404:   let flashColor = new THREE.Color('#ffffff')
405:   const materials = []
406:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.material && !materials.includes(o.material)) materials.push(o.material) })
407:   const baseEmissive = materials.map(m => ({ m, e: m.emissive ? m.emissive.clone() : null, i: m.emissiveIntensity }))
408: 
409:   function update(dt, movement = 0) {
410:     t += dt
411:     walkAmt += (movement - walkAmt) * Math.min(1, dt * 7)
412:     const breathe = Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.014
413:     bodyGroup.scale.set(1 + breathe * 0.4, 1 + breathe, 1 + breathe * 0.3)
414:     bodyGroup.position.y = bodyY + Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.012 + Math.abs(Math.cos(t * 6)) * 0.03 * walkAmt
415:     neckBase.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.1) * 0.04 - 0.04 + walkAmt * 0.06
416:     headGroup.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.4 + 0.7) * 0.05
417:     headGroup.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.13
418:     headGroup.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.02
419: 
420:     tailSegs.forEach((seg, i) => {
421:       seg.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.4) * 0.12 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.05
422:       seg.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.2 + 0.6) * 0.035
423:     })
424:     for (let i = 0; i < wings.length; i++) {
425:       const side = i === 0 ? -1 : 1
426:       wings[i].rotation.z = side * (0.12 + Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 0.18) + side * walkAmt * 0.12
427:       wings[i].rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 0.06
428:     }
429:     for (const leg of legs) {
430:       const phase = walkAmt > 0.02 ? Math.sin(t * 7.5 + leg.phase) : 0
431:       leg.group.rotation.x = (leg.front ? 0.06 : -0.06) + phase * 0.5 * walkAmt
432:       leg.knee.rotation.x = Math.max(0, -phase) * 0.6 * walkAmt
433:     }
434:     for (const arm of arms) {
435:       arm.group.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 7.5 + (arm.side < 0 ? Math.PI : 0)) * 0.16 * walkAmt
436:     }
437:     if (flashTime > 0) {
438:       flashTime -= dt
439:       const k = Math.max(0, flashTime / 0.18)
440:       for (const b of baseEmissive) {
441:         if (!b.e) continue
442:         b.m.emissive.copy(b.e).lerp(flashColor, k)
443:         b.m.emissiveIntensity = b.i + k * 2.4
444:       }
445:     }
446:   }
447: 
448:   function flash(color = '#ffffff', duration = 0.18) {
449:     flashColor.set(color)
450:     flashTime = duration
451:   }
452: 
453:   function dispose() {
454:     model.traverse(o => {
455:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose()
456:     })
457:     for (const m of materials) m.dispose()
458:     root.removeFromParent()
459:   }
460: 
461:   root.userData = { update, flash, dispose, phenotype: p, materials }
462:   root.scale.setScalar(opts.scale ?? 1)
463:   root.name = 'creature'
464:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true } })
465:   return root
466: }
467: 
468: // ─── portrait snapshot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
469: let portraitRenderer = null
470: export function portraitDataURL(genome, size = 220) {
471:   if (!portraitRenderer) {
472:     portraitRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true })
473:     portraitRenderer.setPixelRatio(1)
474:     portraitRenderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
475:     portraitRenderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping
476:     portraitRenderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.1
477:     portraitRenderer.shadowMap.enabled = false
478:   }
479:   portraitRenderer.setSize(size, size, false)
480:   const scene = new THREE.Scene()
481:   const creature = buildCreature(genome)
482:   // face three-quarter
483:   creature.rotation.y = -0.5
484:   creature.update(0.2, 0)
485:   scene.add(creature)
486:   const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(creature)
487:   const sphere = box.getBoundingSphere(new THREE.Sphere())
488:   const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(34, 1, 0.1, 100)
489:   const dist = sphere.radius / Math.sin((34 * Math.PI / 180) / 2) * 0.84
490:   cam.position.set(sphere.center.x + dist * 0.18, sphere.center.y + dist * 0.18, sphere.center.z + dist)
491:   cam.lookAt(sphere.center)
492:   scene.add(cam)
493:   scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xcffcff, 0x203030, 2.2))
494:   const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3d6, 3.2)
495:   key.position.set(3, 5, 4)
496:   scene.add(key)
497:   const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x6fffd7, 2.2)
498:   rim.position.set(-4, 2, -3)
499:   scene.add(rim)
500:   portraitRenderer.render(scene, cam)
501:   const url = portraitRenderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86)
502:   creature.userData.dispose()
503:   return url
504: }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand “Helix Forge — Creature Lab” with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts connected to creature discovery and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected genome/phenotype generation, creature mesh construction, discovery flow, UI, and build scripts.
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`.

### Active
- Add phenotype support and render the new traits on creature meshes.
- Expose body-part selection during creature discovery.
- Build and verify the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot at no more than 1280px wide, and inspect that screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add phenotype values for the new genes in `src/dna.js`, preserving compatibility with older saves and breeding.
2. Render those traits in `src/creature.js` and expose selection when discovering a creature in `src/app.js`.
3. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, genome generation, phenotype, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow, UI, and genome dossier.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.

## Important Context
- New gene definitions are present, but phenotype and visual integration are not yet implemented.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

38: export const GENE_MAP = Object.fromEntries(GENES.map(g => [g.key, g]))
39: 
40: const clamp = (v, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
41: export const clamp01 = v => clamp(v)
42: export const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t
43: export const mix = (a, b, t) => Math.round(a + (b - a) * t)
44: 
45: export function mulberry32(seed) {
46:   let a = seed >>> 0
47:   return function () {
48:     a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
49:     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
50:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
51:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
52:   }
53: }
54: 
55: const rnd = (min, max) => min + Math.random() * (max - min)
56: 
57: // ─── genome creation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
58: export function randomGenome(seed, bias = {}) {
59:   const r = seed == null ? Math.random : mulberry32(seed)
60:   const genome = {}
61:   for (const gene of GENES) {
62:     const b = bias[gene.key] ?? 0.5
63:     const spread = bias[gene.key + '_spread'] ?? 0.34
64:     const center = clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * spread, 0.06, 0.96)
65:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
66:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
67:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
68:     if (bias._wild) {
69:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
70:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
71:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
72:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
73:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
74:         : [r(), r()]
75:     } else {
76:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]
77:     }
78:   }
79:   return genome
80: }
81: 
82: // Phenotype: average expression; a few genes skew dominant to create variety.
83: export function phenotype(genome) {
84:   const p = {}
85:   for (const gene of GENES) {
86:     // Older local saves predate newer appearance genes; keep them playable.
87:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome[gene.key] || []
88:     p[gene.key] = (a + b) / 2
89:   }
90:   // Derived composite values used by the mesh builder.
91:   const size = p.size
92:   p.height = 0.72 + size * 0.62 + p.legs * 0.18
93:   p.huePrimary = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueA))
94:   p.hueAccent = Math.round(lerp(0, 360, p.hueB))
95:   p.sat = Math.round(38 + p.pattern * 34 + p.muscle * 10)
96:   p.lightness = Math.round(52 - p.bone * 12 + p.eyes * 4)
97:   p.bodyColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary} ${p.sat}% ${p.lightness}%)`
98:   p.accentColor = `hsl(${p.hueAccent} ${Math.min(92, p.sat + 18)}% ${58 + p.eyes * 8}%)`
99:   p.darkColor = `hsl(${p.huePrimary - 12} ${p.sat + 6}% ${Math.max(18, p.lightness - 26)}%)`
100:   p.eyeColor = `hsl(${(p.hueAccent + 38) % 360} 100% ${62 + p.brain * 10}%)`
101:   p.speciesType = ['Drake', 'Mireling', 'Skykin', 'Goliath'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))]
102:   p.skinType = ['Velvet hide', 'Scaled hide', 'Plated hide', 'Crystal hide'][Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.hide * 4))]
103:   p.postureName = p.posture > 0.58 ? 'Biped' : 'Quadruped'
104:   p.skinRoughness = 0.9 - p.hide * 0.62
105:   p.horniness = p.horns
106:   p.limbCount = 4
107:   return p
108: }
109: 
110: // ─── stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
111: export const STAT_KEYS = ['power', 'bones', 'mobility', 'muscle', 'brain', 'condition']
112: export const STAT_META = {
113:   power:    { label: 'Ability',  color: '#d8ff5f', short: 'PWR' },
114:   bones:    { label: 'Bones',    color: '#ffd36e', short: 'BON' },
115:   mobility: { label: 'Mobility', color: '#67e8f9', short: 'MOB' },
116:   muscle:   { label: 'Muscle',   color: '#ff8a7a', short: 'MUS' },
117:   brain:    { label: 'Brain',    color: '#c4a7ff', short: 'BRN' },
118:   condition:{ label: 'Condition',color: '#8fffc0', short: 'CON' },
119: }
120: 
121: export function averageNeeds(needs) {
122:   return (needs.hunger + needs.energy + needs.hygiene + needs.fun) / 4
123: }
124: 
125: export function heterozygosity(genome) {
126:   let sum = 0
127:   for (const gene of GENES) {
128:     const [a = 0.5, b = 0.5] = genome?.[gene.key] || []
129:     sum += Math.abs(a - b)
130:   }
131:   return sum / GENES.length
132: }
133: 
134: export function conditionOf(creature) {
135:   if (!creature) return 0
136:   const needs = creature.needs
137:   const vitality = averageNeeds(needs)
138:   const vigor = clamp01(heterozygosity(creature.genome) * 1.8) * 9
139:   const levelBonus = Math.min(6, (creature.wins || 0) * 0.8)
140:   const raw = vitality * 0.88 + vigor + levelBonus + 4
141:   return Math.round(clamp(raw, 4, 100))
142: }
143: 
144: export function statsOf(creature) {
145:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
146:   const cond = conditionOf(creature)
147:   const condMul = 0.72 + (cond / 100) * 0.28
148:   const raw = {
149:     power: 12 + p.size * 18 + p.muscle * 30 + p.bone * 14 + p.horns * 12 + p.snout * 6 + p.armor * 7,
150:     bones: 8 + p.bone * 84 + p.armor * 8,
151:     mobility: 8 + p.legs * 25 + p.speed * 32 + (1 - p.stance) * 12 + p.wings * 14 - p.size * 7,
152:     muscle: 6 + p.muscle * 88 + p.stance * 6,
153:     brain: 5 + p.brain * 88 + p.eyes * 7,
154:     condition: cond,
155:   }
156:   const out = {}
157:   for (const k of STAT_KEYS) out[k] = Math.round(clamp(k === 'condition' ? raw[k] : raw[k] * condMul, 3, 100))
158:   return out
159: }
160: 
161: export function maxHpOf(creature) {
162:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
163:   const stats = statsOf(creature)
164:   return Math.round(64 + p.size * 58 + p.bone * 34 + stats.muscle * 0.28 + p.armor * 16 + (creature.wins || 0) * 3)
165: }
166: 
167: export function maxStaminaOf(creature) {
168:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
169:   return Math.round(58 + p.speed * 34 + p.legs * 18 + p.brain * 10 + p.wings * 10)
170: }
171: 
172: export function needsProfile(creature) {
173:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
174:   return {
175:     hunger: 0.24 + p.metabolism * 0.33 + p.size * 0.13,
176:     energy: 0.10 + p.speed * 0.12 + p.size * 0.06 + p.wings * 0.05,
177:     hygiene: 0.05 + p.armor * 0.04 + p.pattern * 0.05,
178:     fun: 0.07 + p.brain * 0.15 + p.speed * 0.04,
179:   }
180: }
181: 
182: export function decayNeeds(creature, seconds) {
183:   const rate = needsProfile(creature)
184:   for (const k of ['hunger', 'energy', 'hygiene', 'fun']) {
185:     creature.needs[k] = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, creature.needs[k] - rate[k] * seconds))
186:   }
187: }
188: 
189: export function freshNeeds(value = 82) {
190:   return { hunger: value, energy: value, hygiene: value, fun: value }
191: }
192: 
193: // ─── movement / battle traits ──────────────────────────────────────────────
194: export function movesFor(creature) {
195:   const p = phenotype(creature.genome)
196:   const moves = []
197:   moves.push({
198:     id: 'bite', name: 'Rend', icon: '⚔', type: 'strike', cost: 11,
199:     power: 0.92 + p.snout * 0.38 + p.head * 0.14,
200:     acc: 0.88 + p.eyes * 0.08, tag: 'JAW',
201:     desc: 'A snapping bite. Reliable and cheap.',
202:     fx: 'bite',
203:   })

## Objective
- Expand “Helix Forge — Creature Lab” with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new body-part genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`.
- Added `NEW_BODY_PARTS` and `allelesOf` helpers in `src/dna.js` to default missing new traits to `[0.04, 0.04]`.

### Active
- Integrate the new genes into phenotype generation and render their traits on creature meshes.
- Expose body-part selection during creature discovery.
- Build and verify the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot at no more than 1280px wide, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Use the new-allele defaults consistently in phenotype generation and breeding, preserving old-save compatibility.
2. Add 3D geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
3. Add trait selection to discovery in `src/app.js` and show the new adaptation genes in the dossier.
4. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot at no more than 1280px wide.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, phenotype, allele defaults, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow and genome dossier UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.

## Important Context
- Current discovery uses `generateWild()` and immediately adds the creature; body-part choice has not yet been added.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

269:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
270:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
271:     let a = pickA, b = pickB

- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, save a JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new body-part genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`.
- Added `NEW_BODY_PARTS` and `allelesOf` helpers in `src/dna.js` to default missing new traits to `[0.04, 0.04]`.

### Active
- Integrate the new-allele defaults consistently into phenotype generation and breeding.
- Add 3D geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
- Add body-part selection during discovery and show adaptation genes in the dossier in `src/app.js`.
- Build and verify the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Use `allelesOf` in phenotype generation and breeding, preserving old-save compatibility.
2. Add geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
3. Update discovery UI/flow and genome dossier gene groups in `src/app.js`.
4. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture the latest JPEG screenshot at no more than 1280px wide, and inspect it.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, phenotype, allele defaults, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow and genome dossier UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture script.

## Important Context
- Discovery currently calls `generateWild()` and immediately adds the creature; body-part choice has not yet been added.
- `allelesOf` exists but phenotype and breeding still use their prior allele fallback logic.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

48: export function mulberry32(seed) {
49:   let a = seed >>> 0
50:   return function () {

52:     let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
53:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
54:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296

61: export function randomGenome(seed, bias = {}) {
62:   const r = seed == null ? Math.random : mulberry32(seed)
63:   const genome = {}
64:   for (const gene of GENES) {
65:     const b = bias[gene.key] ?? 0.5
66:     const spread = bias[gene.key + '_spread'] ?? 0.34
67:     const center = clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * spread, 0.06, 0.96)
68:     const alleleA = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
69:     const alleleB = clamp(center + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, 0.02, 0.98)
70:     // Wild finds span the full trait range; bred lineages remain centered on parents.
71:     if (bias._wild) {
72:       genome[gene.key] = [r(), r()]
73:     // Hue genes are stored as full-range values, not centred on 0.5
74:     } else if (gene.key === 'hueA' || gene.key === 'hueB') {
75:       genome[gene.key] = bias[gene.key] != null
76:         ? [clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18), clamp(b + (r() - 0.5) * 0.18)]
77:         : [r(), r()]
78:     } else {
79:       genome[gene.key] = [alleleA, alleleB]
80:     }
81:   }
82:   return genome

251: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
252:   let sum = 0
253:   for (const gene of GENES) {
254:     const allelesA = a?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
255:     const allelesB = b?.[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
256:     const pa = ((allelesA[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesA[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
257:     const pb = ((allelesB[0] ?? 0.5) + (allelesB[1] ?? 0.5)) / 2
258:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
259:   }
260:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
261: }

263: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
264:   const child = {}
265:   const mutations = []
266:   for (const gene of GENES) {
267:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
268:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
269:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
270:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
271:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
272:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
273:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
274:       mutations.push(gene.key)
275:     }
276:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
277:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
278:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
279:     }
280:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
281:   }
282:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
283: }

340:       for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) seq += bases[(n >> (j * 2)) & 3]

342:     seq += '·'

160: export function buildCreature(genome, opts = {}) {

162:   const root = new THREE.Group()
163:   const model = new THREE.Group()

166:   const s = 0.78 + p.size * 0.52
167:   const species = Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))
168:   const biped = p.posture > 0.58
169:   const typeWidth = [1, 1.16, 0.78, 1.27][species]
170:   const typeLength = [1, 1.12, 0.86, 1.08][species]
171:   const torsoRY = (0.5 + p.girth * 0.3) * s * [1, 0.98, 0.82, 1.2][species]
172:   const torsoRX = (0.52 + p.girth * 0.48) * s * typeWidth
173:   const torsoRZ = (0.62 + p.length * 0.55) * s * typeLength
174:   const legLen = (0.34 + p.legs * 0.62) * s * [1, 0.9, 1.22, 0.82][species] * (biped ? 1.04 : 1)
175:   const legThick = (0.09 + p.stance * 0.12) * [1, 0.9, 0.78, 1.42][species]
176:   const hipY = legLen + torsoRY * 0.42
177:   const headScale = (0.34 + p.head * 0.36) * s * [1, 1.05, 0.88, 1.22][species]
178:   const bodyY = legLen + torsoRY * (biped ? 0.62 : 0.55)
179: 
180:   const coat = coatTexture(p, 'body')
181:   const bodyMat = mat(0xffffff, { map: coat, roughness: 0.66 })
182:   const darkMat = mat(p.darkColor, { roughness: 0.8 })
183:   const accentMat = mat(p.accentColor, { roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.12 })
184:   const boneMat = mat('#e8dfc4', { roughness: 0.62, flat: true })
185:   const clawMat = mat('#332f27', { roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.2 })
186:   const eyeMat = mat(p.eyeColor, { emissive: p.eyeColor, emissiveIntensity: 2.1, roughness: 0.2 })
187:   const pupilMat = mat('#0a0d0c', { roughness: 0.3 })

189: 
190:   const bodyGroup = new THREE.Group()
191:   bodyGroup.position.y = bodyY
192:   model.add(bodyGroup)
193: 
194:   const torsoGeo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2)
195:   const torsoTilt = biped ? -0.62 : 0
196:   const torso = addMesh(bodyGroup, torsoGeo, bodyMat, [0, 0, 0], [torsoTilt, 0, 0], [torsoRX, torsoRY, torsoRZ])
197:   // belly plate follows the body plan's torso angle.
198:   addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1), mat(p.accentColor, { roughness: 0.7 }), [0, -torsoRY * 0.55, torsoRZ * 0.05], [torsoTilt, 0, 0], [torsoRX * 0.8, torsoRY * 0.42, torsoRZ * 0.86])
199: 
200:   // ── neck & head ──
201:   const neckBase = new THREE.Group()
202:   neckBase.position.set(0, torsoRY * (biped ? 0.36 : 0.3), torsoRZ * 0.62)
203:   bodyGroup.add(neckBase)
204:   const neckLen = (0.16 + p.neck * 0.62) * s * [1, 1.34, 1.08, 0.76][species]
205:   const neckGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.17 * s, neckLen, 3, 8)
206:   addMesh(neckBase, neckGeo, bodyMat, [0, neckLen * 0.34, 0.06 * s], [-0.62 + p.neck * 0.2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1.05 + p.neck * 0.3])
207: 
208:   const headGroup = new THREE.Group()
209:   headGroup.position.set(0, neckLen * 0.82 + 0.06 * s, neckLen * 0.48)
210:   neckBase.add(headGroup)
211:   const skull = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2), bodyMat, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [headScale, headScale * 0.82, headScale * 1.02])
212:   // jaw / snout

217:     [0, -headScale * 0.38, headScale * 0.7 + snoutLen * 0.24], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.6])

223:   // eyes

235:   for (let pair = 0; pair < hornPairs; pair++) {

238:       const horn = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.14, len, 6), boneMat,

400:   // animation state
401:   let t = Math.random() * 10
402:   let walkAmt = 0
403:   let flashTime = 0
404:   let flashColor = new THREE.Color('#ffffff')
405:   const materials = []

409:   function update(dt, movement = 0) {

411:     walkAmt += (movement - walkAmt) * Math.min(1, dt * 7)

413:     bodyGroup.scale.set(1 + breathe * 0.4, 1 + breathe, 1 + breathe * 0.3)

416:     headGroup.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.4 + 0.7) * 0.05
417:     headGroup.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.13
418:     headGroup.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.02
419: 
420:     tailSegs.forEach((seg, i) => {
421:       seg.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.4) * 0.12 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.05
422:       seg.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.2 + 0.6) * 0.035
423:     })
424:     for (let i = 0; i < wings.length; i++) {
425:       const side = i === 0 ? -1 : 1
426:       wings[i].rotation.z = side * (0.12 + Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 0.18) + side * walkAmt * 0.12
427:       wings[i].rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 0.06
428:     }
429:     for (const leg of legs) {
430:       const phase = walkAmt > 0.02 ? Math.sin(t * 7.5 + leg.phase) : 0
431:       leg.group.rotation.x = (leg.front ? 0.06 : -0.06) + phase * 0.5 * walkAmt
432:       leg.knee.rotation.x = Math.max(0, -phase) * 0.6 * walkAmt
433:     }
434:     for (const arm of arms) {
435:       arm.group.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 7.5 + (arm.side < 0 ? Math.PI : 0)) * 0.16 * walkAmt
436:     }
437:     if (flashTime > 0) {
438:       flashTime -= dt
439:       const k = Math.max(0, flashTime / 0.18)
440:       for (const b of baseEmissive) {
441:         if (!b.e) continue
442:         b.m.emissive.copy(b.e).lerp(flashColor, k)
443:         b.m.emissiveIntensity = b.i + k * 2.4
444:       }
445:     }
446:   }
447: 
448:   function flash(color = '#ffffff', duration = 0.18) {
449:     flashColor.set(color)
450:     flashTime = duration
451:   }
452: 
453:   function dispose() {
454:     model.traverse(o => {
455:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose()
456:     })
457:     for (const m of materials) m.dispose()
458:     root.removeFromParent()
459:   }

461:   root.userData = { update, flash, dispose, phenotype: p, materials }
462:   root.scale.setScalar(opts.scale ?? 1)
463:   root.name = 'creature'
464:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true } })
465:   return root
466: }

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, save and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot (no wider than 1280px).

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new body-part genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`.
- Added `NEW_BODY_PARTS` and `allelesOf` helpers in `src/dna.js`, defaulting missing new traits to `[0.04, 0.04]`.

### Active
- Integrate `allelesOf` consistently into phenotype generation and breeding.
- Add 3D geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
- Add body-part selection during discovery and show adaptation genes in the dossier in `src/app.js`.
- Build and verify the game; capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot within the requested width.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Use `allelesOf` for phenotype generation and breeding while preserving compatibility with older saves.
2. Add geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
3. Update discovery flow to allow body-part selection and organize/show adaptation genes in the dossier in `src/app.js`.
4. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, phenotype, allele defaults, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow and genome dossier UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture script.

## Important Context
- Discovery currently generates and immediately adds a wild creature; body-part choice is not yet implemented.
- `allelesOf` exists but phenotype and breeding still use their earlier fallback logic.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, breeding, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, save and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot (no wider than 1280px).

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new body-part genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`.
- Added `NEW_BODY_PARTS` and `allelesOf` helpers in `src/dna.js`, defaulting missing new traits to `[0.04, 0.04]`.

### Active
- Integrate `allelesOf` consistently into phenotype generation and breeding.
- Add 3D geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
- Update discovery flow to allow body-part selection and organize/show adaptation genes in the dossier in `src/app.js`.
- Build and verify the game; capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot within the requested width.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Use `allelesOf` for phenotype generation and breeding while preserving compatibility with older saves.
2. Add geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
3. Update discovery flow to allow body-part selection and organize/show adaptation genes in the dossier in `src/app.js`.
4. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, phenotype, allele defaults, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow and genome dossier UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture script.

## Important Context
- Discovery currently generates and immediately adds a wild creature; body-part choice is not yet implemented.
- `allelesOf` exists but phenotype and breeding still use their earlier fallback logic.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.

269:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
270:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
271:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
272:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
273:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
274:       mutations.push(gene.key)

278:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)

281:   }
282:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }

## Objective
- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, breeding, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, saving and inspecting only the latest JPEG screenshot at a width of 1280px or less.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.
- Capture and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot, no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`.

### Active
- Integrate `allelesOf` consistently into phenotype generation and breeding while preserving compatibility with older saves.
- Add geometry for new traits in `src/creature.js`.
- Update discovery flow to allow body-part selection and organize/show adaptation genes in the dossier in `src/app.js` and `src/style.css`.
- Build and verify the game; capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot within the requested width.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Apply `allelesOf` consistently to phenotype generation and breeding, preserving old-save defaults.
2. Add geometry for ears, fins, gills, antennae, elytra, and extra legs in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement discovery body-part selection and adaptation gene dossier display in `src/app.js` and `src/style.css`.
4. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot at 1280px wide or less, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, phenotype, allele defaults, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow and genome dossier UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture script.

## Important Context
- `src/dna.js` has uncommitted changes, including `GENES`, `NEW_BODY_PARTS`, and `allelesOf`; phenotype and breeding still use their earlier fallback logic.
- Discovery currently generates and immediately adds a wild creature; body-part choice is not implemented.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

## Objective
- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with selectable animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, breeding, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, saving and inspecting only the latest JPEG screenshot at a width of 1280px or less.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.
- Capture and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot, no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`.
### Active
- Integrate `allelesOf` consistently into phenotype generation and breeding while preserving compatibility with older saves.
- Add geometry for new traits in `src/creature.js`.
- Implement discovery body-part selection and adaptation gene dossier display in `src/app.js` and `src/style.css`.
- Build and verify the game; capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot within the requested width.
### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Apply `allelesOf` consistently to phenotype generation and breeding, preserving old-save defaults.
2. Add geometry for ears, fins, gills, antennae, elytra, and extra legs in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement discovery body-part selection and adaptation gene dossier display in `src/app.js` and `src/style.css`.
4. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot at 1280px wide or less, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, phenotype, allele defaults, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow and genome dossier UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture script.

## Important Context
- `src/dna.js` has uncommitted changes, including `GENES`, `NEW_BODY_PARTS`, and `allelesOf`; phenotype and breeding still use their earlier fallback logic.
- Discovery currently generates and immediately adds a wild creature; body-part choice is not implemented.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

## Objective
- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, breeding, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, saving and inspecting only the latest JPEG screenshot at a width of 1280px or less.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.
- Capture and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot, no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions and low-expression missing-allele defaults in `src/dna.js`.
- Updated phenotype generation to use `allelesOf` for consistent defaults.

### Active
- Integrate `allelesOf` into breeding and other genome calculations where needed.
- Add geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
- Implement discovery body-part selection and adaptation gene dossier display in `src/app.js` and `src/style.css`.
- Build and verify the game; capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot within the requested width.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Apply `allelesOf` consistently to breeding and other genome calculations while preserving old-save defaults.
2. Add geometry for ears, fins, gills, antennae, elytra, and extra legs in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement discovery body-part selection and adaptation gene dossier display in `src/app.js` and `src/style.css`.
4. Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot at 1280px wide or less, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, phenotype, allele defaults, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow and genome dossier UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Existing screenshot capture script.

## Important Context
- Changes in `src/dna.js` are uncommitted; the working tree previously showed only this file modified.
- `allelesOf` defaults absent new body-part genes to `[0.04, 0.04]` and other missing genes to `[0.5, 0.5]`.
- Discovery currently generates and immediately adds a wild creature; body-part choice is not implemented.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

136:     roughness: opts.roughness ?? 0.72,
137:     metalness: opts.metalness ?? 0.04,
138:     flatShading: opts.flat ?? false,
139:     emissive: opts.emissive ?? 0x000000,
140:     emissiveIntensity: opts.emissiveIntensity ?? 1,
141:     transparent: opts.transparent ?? false,
142:     opacity: opts.opacity ?? 1,
143:     side: opts.side ?? THREE.FrontSide,
144:     map: opts.map,
145:   })
146: }
147: 
148: function addMesh(parent, geo, material, pos = [0, 0, 0], rot = [0, 0, 0], scl = [1, 1, 1]) {
149:   const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material)
150:   m.position.set(...pos)
151:   m.rotation.set(...rot)
152:   m.scale.set(...scl)
153:   m.castShadow = true
154:   m.receiveShadow = true
155:   parent.add(m)
156:   return m
157: }
158: 
159: // ─── creature mesh ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
160: export function buildCreature(genome, opts = {}) {
161:   const p = phenotype(genome)
162:   const root = new THREE.Group()
163:   const model = new THREE.Group()
164:   root.add(model)
165: 
166:   const s = 0.78 + p.size * 0.52
167:   const species = Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))
168:   const biped = p.posture > 0.58
169:   const typeWidth = [1, 1.16, 0.78, 1.27][species]
170:   const typeLength = [1, 1.12, 0.86, 1.08][species]
171:   const torsoRY = (0.5 + p.girth * 0.3) * s * [1, 0.98, 0.82, 1.2][species]
172:   const torsoRX = (0.52 + p.girth * 0.48) * s * typeWidth
173:   const torsoRZ = (0.62 + p.length * 0.55) * s * typeLength
174:   const legLen = (0.34 + p.legs * 0.62) * s * [1, 0.9, 1.22, 0.82][species] * (biped ? 1.04 : 1)
175:   const legThick = (0.09 + p.stance * 0.12) * [1, 0.9, 0.78, 1.42][species]
176:   const hipY = legLen + torsoRY * 0.42
177:   const headScale = (0.34 + p.head * 0.36) * s * [1, 1.05, 0.88, 1.22][species]
178:   const bodyY = legLen + torsoRY * (biped ? 0.62 : 0.55)
179: 
180:   const coat = coatTexture(p, 'body')
181:   const bodyMat = mat(0xffffff, { map: coat, roughness: 0.66 })
182:   const darkMat = mat(p.darkColor, { roughness: 0.8 })
183:   const accentMat = mat(p.accentColor, { roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.12 })
184:   const boneMat = mat('#e8dfc4', { roughness: 0.62, flat: true })
185:   const clawMat = mat('#332f27', { roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.2 })
186:   const eyeMat = mat(p.eyeColor, { emissive: p.eyeColor, emissiveIntensity: 2.1, roughness: 0.2 })
187:   const pupilMat = mat('#0a0d0c', { roughness: 0.3 })
188:   const wingMat = mat(p.accentColor, { transparent: true, opacity: 0.72, side: THREE.DoubleSide, roughness: 0.5, emissive: p.darkColor, emissiveIntensity: 0.16 })
189: 
190:   const bodyGroup = new THREE.Group()
191:   bodyGroup.position.y = bodyY
192:   model.add(bodyGroup)
193: 
194:   const torsoGeo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2)
195:   const torsoTilt = biped ? -0.62 : 0
196:   const torso = addMesh(bodyGroup, torsoGeo, bodyMat, [0, 0, 0], [torsoTilt, 0, 0], [torsoRX, torsoRY, torsoRZ])
197:   // belly plate follows the body plan's torso angle.
198:   addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1), mat(p.accentColor, { roughness: 0.7 }), [0, -torsoRY * 0.55, torsoRZ * 0.05], [torsoTilt, 0, 0], [torsoRX * 0.8, torsoRY * 0.42, torsoRZ * 0.86])
199: 
200:   // ── neck & head ──
201:   const neckBase = new THREE.Group()
202:   neckBase.position.set(0, torsoRY * (biped ? 0.36 : 0.3), torsoRZ * 0.62)
203:   bodyGroup.add(neckBase)
204:   const neckLen = (0.16 + p.neck * 0.62) * s * [1, 1.34, 1.08, 0.76][species]
205:   const neckGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.17 * s, neckLen, 3, 8)
206:   addMesh(neckBase, neckGeo, bodyMat, [0, neckLen * 0.34, 0.06 * s], [-0.62 + p.neck * 0.2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1.05 + p.neck * 0.3])
207: 
208:   const headGroup = new THREE.Group()
209:   headGroup.position.set(0, neckLen * 0.82 + 0.06 * s, neckLen * 0.48)
210:   neckBase.add(headGroup)
211:   const skull = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2), bodyMat, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [headScale, headScale * 0.82, headScale * 1.02])
212:   // jaw / snout
213:   const snoutLen = headScale * (0.72 + p.snout * 0.78)
214:   addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(headScale * 0.41, snoutLen, 3, 8), darkMat,
215:     [0, -headScale * 0.18, headScale * 0.62 + snoutLen * 0.34], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.8])
216:   addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(headScale * 0.3, snoutLen * 0.68, 3, 8), bodyMat,
217:     [0, -headScale * 0.38, headScale * 0.7 + snoutLen * 0.24], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.6])
218:   // teeth
219:   const toothGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.055, headScale * 0.19, 4)
220:   for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
221:     addMesh(headGroup, toothGeo, boneMat, [(i - 1.5) * headScale * 0.16, -headScale * 0.48, headScale * 0.72 + snoutLen * 0.4 + (i % 2) * 0.02], [Math.PI, 0, 0])
222:   }
223:   // eyes
224:   const eyeR = headScale * (0.13 + p.eyes * 0.1)
225:   for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
226:     const ex = side * headScale * 0.58, ey = headScale * 0.16, ez = headScale * 0.62
227:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.SphereGeometry(eyeR, 14, 10), eyeMat, [ex, ey, ez], [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.7])
228:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.SphereGeometry(eyeR * 0.48, 10, 8), pupilMat, [ex + side * eyeR * 0.35, ey, ez + eyeR * 0.5], [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.5])
229:   }
230:   // brow ridge
231:   addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.BoxGeometry(headScale * 0.95, headScale * 0.16, headScale * 0.34), darkMat, [0, headScale * 0.36, headScale * 0.5], [0.18, 0, 0])
232: 
233:   // horns
234:   const hornPairs = p.horns > 0.74 ? 3 : p.horns > 0.46 ? 2 : p.horns > 0.16 ? 1 : 0
235:   for (let pair = 0; pair < hornPairs; pair++) {
236:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
237:       const len = headScale * (0.55 + p.horns * 1.15) * (1 - pair * 0.22)
238:       const horn = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.14, len, 6), boneMat,
239:         [side * (headScale * 0.34 + pair * headScale * 0.12), headScale * 0.6 + pair * headScale * 0.15, headScale * (0.18 - pair * 0.24)],
240:         [-0.35, 0, side * -(0.25 + pair * 0.2)], [1, 1, 1])
241:       horn.castShadow = true
242:     }
243:   }
244:   // crest / ear fins
245:   if (p.wings > 0.3) {
246:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
247:       const fin = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.26, headScale * 0.7, 4), wingMat,
248:         [side * headScale * 0.7, headScale * 0.15, -headScale * 0.15], [0, 0, side * -1.15], [1, 0.3, 1])
249:       fin.material = wingMat
250:     }
251:   }
252: 
253:   // ── back spikes ──
254:   if (p.armor > 0.2) {
255:     const count = 2 + Math.floor(p.armor * 7)
256:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
257:       const t = i / (count - 1 || 1)
258:       const h = torsoRY * (1.05 - t * 0.5) * (0.55 + p.armor * 0.55)
259:       const spike = addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(torsoRX * 0.16, h, 4), boneMat,
260:         [0, torsoRY * (0.72 - Math.abs(t - 0.4) * 0.5), torsoRZ * (0.62 - t * 1.25)],
261:         [-0.24, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1])
262:       spike.castShadow = true
263:     }
264:   }
265:   // shoulder scutes
266:   for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
267:     addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0), darkMat,
268:       [side * torsoRX * 0.72, torsoRY * 0.34, torsoRZ * 0.3], [0, 0, side * 0.4], [torsoRX * 0.26, torsoRY * 0.2, torsoRZ * 0.42])
269:   }
270:   // Species-specific silhouette details make the four archetypes readable at a glance.
271:   if (species === 1) { // Mireling: paired cheek/gill frills along a broad ribcage.
272:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
273:       addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(torsoRY * 0.16, torsoRY * 0.68, 5), accentMat,
274:         [side * torsoRX * 0.88, torsoRY * (0.28 - i * 0.08), torsoRZ * (0.42 - i * 0.48)],
275:         [0, 0, side * -1.05], [0.72, 1, 0.48])
276:     }
277:   } else if (species === 2) { // Skykin: swept feather crest, even when wing membranes are small.
278:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
279:       addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.12, headScale * (0.52 + i * 0.12), 5), wingMat,
280:         [(i - 1) * headScale * 0.2, headScale * 0.68, -headScale * (0.12 + i * 0.12)],
281:         [-0.5, 0, (i - 1) * 0.16])
282:     }
283:   }
284: 
285:   // ── tail ──
286:   const tailSegs = []
287:   if (p.tail > 0.08) {
288:     let parent = new THREE.Group()
289:     parent.position.set(0, torsoRY * 0.12, -torsoRZ * 0.92)
290:     bodyGroup.add(parent)
291:     const segCount = 4
292:     for (let i = 0; i < segCount; i++) {
293:       const seg = new THREE.Group()
294:       const r = (0.2 - i * 0.032) * s * (0.7 + p.tail * 0.7) * [1, 0.88, 0.78, 1.32][species]
295:       const len = (0.32 + p.tail * 0.42) * s * [1, 1.22, 1.08, 0.82][species]
296:       seg.position.z = i === 0 ? 0 : -len * 0.92
297:       const g = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(Math.max(0.045, r), len, 2, 7)
298:       addMesh(seg, g, i % 2 === 0 ? bodyMat : darkMat, [0, 0, -len * 0.46], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0])
299:       parent.add(seg)
300:       tailSegs.push(seg)
301:       parent = seg
302:       if (i === segCount - 1 && p.armor > 0.3) {
303:         addMesh(seg, new THREE.ConeGeometry(r * 1.2, len * 1.1, 5), boneMat, [0, 0, -len * 1.1], [-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0])
304:       }
305:     }
306:   }
307: 
308:   // ── wings ──
309:   const wings = []
310:   if (p.wings > 0.42) {
311:     const wingGroup = new THREE.Group()
312:     wingGroup.position.set(0, torsoRY * 0.5, torsoRZ * 0.05)
313:     bodyGroup.add(wingGroup)
314:     const span = (0.9 + p.wings * 1.35) * s * [1, 0.92, 1.28, 1.05][species]
315:     const height = (0.6 + p.wings * 0.9) * s * [1, 0.94, 1.22, 1.08][species]
316:     const shape = new THREE.Shape()
317:     shape.moveTo(0, 0)
318:     shape.quadraticCurveTo(span * 0.55, height * 0.7, span, height * 0.18)
319:     shape.quadraticCurveTo(span * 0.7, -height * 0.12, span * 0.38, -height * 0.28)
320:     shape.quadraticCurveTo(span * 0.22, -height * 0.08, 0, 0)
321:     const wingGeo = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shape, 12)
322:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
323:       const pivot = new THREE.Group()
324:       pivot.rotation.z = side * 0.18
325:       wingGroup.add(pivot)
326:       const w = new THREE.Mesh(wingGeo, wingMat)
327:       w.scale.x = side
328:       w.castShadow = true
329:       pivot.add(w)
330:       // leading edge strut
331:       const bone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.028 * s, 0.045 * s, span, 5), darkMat)
332:       bone.position.set(side * span * 0.46, height * 0.22, 0)
333:       bone.rotation.z = side * -0.42
334:       bone.castShadow = true
335:       wingGroup.add(bone)
336:       wings.push(pivot)
337:     }
338:   }
339: 
340:   // ── legs & biped arms ──
341:   const legs = []
342:   const hips = biped
343:     ? [{ x: -1, z: -0.06, front: true }, { x: 1, z: -0.06, front: true }]
344:     : [
345:         { x: -1, z: 0.48, front: true }, { x: 1, z: 0.48, front: true },
346:         { x: -1, z: -0.5, front: false }, { x: 1, z: -0.5, front: false },
347:       ]
348:   for (const hip of hips) {
349:     const leg = new THREE.Group()
350:     leg.position.set(hip.x * torsoRX * (biped ? 0.43 : 0.62), hipY, hip.z * torsoRZ * (biped ? 0.48 : 0.86))
351:     const scaleLeg = (hip.front ? 0.86 : 1) * (0.8 + p.legs * 0.34) * (biped ? 1.14 : 1)
352:     const upper = legLen * 0.52 * scaleLeg
353:     const lower = legLen * 0.54 * scaleLeg
354:     const thick = legThick * (hip.front ? (biped ? 1.12 : 0.84) : 1.1)
355:     addMesh(leg, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick, upper, 2, 7), bodyMat, [0, -upper * 0.5, 0])
356:     const knee = new THREE.Group()
357:     knee.position.y = -upper
358:     leg.add(knee)
359:     addMesh(knee, new THREE.SphereGeometry(thick * 1.15, 8, 6), darkMat)
360:     addMesh(knee, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick * 0.78, lower * 0.82, 2, 7), darkMat, [0, -lower * 0.45, 0])
361:     const foot = addMesh(knee, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(thick * 1.7, 1), darkMat, [0, -lower * 0.92, thick * 0.55], [0, 0, 0], [biped ? 1.2 : 1.5, 0.55, biped ? 1.45 : 1.9])
362:     foot.castShadow = true
363:     for (let c = -1; c <= 1; c++) {
364:       addMesh(knee, new THREE.ConeGeometry(thick * 0.3, thick * 1.15, 4), clawMat,
365:         [c * thick * 0.7, -lower * 0.94, thick * 1.4], [Math.PI / 2.2, 0, 0])
366:     }
367:     leg.rotation.x = hip.front ? 0.06 : -0.06
368:     legs.push({ group: leg, knee, front: hip.front, phase: hip.x > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI })
369:     model.add(leg)
370:   }
371:   const arms = []
372:   if (biped) {
373:     const armLen = legLen * 0.72
374:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
375:       const arm = new THREE.Group()
376:       arm.position.set(side * torsoRX * 0.72, torsoRY * 0.52, torsoRZ * 0.18)
377:       arm.rotation.z = side * 0.16
378:       const upper = armLen * 0.54, fore = armLen * 0.48, thick = legThick * 0.68
379:       addMesh(arm, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick, upper, 2, 7), bodyMat, [0, -upper * 0.42, 0])
380:       const elbow = new THREE.Group()
381:       elbow.position.y = -upper * 0.84
382:       arm.add(elbow)
383:       addMesh(elbow, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick * 0.76, fore, 2, 7), darkMat, [0, -fore * 0.42, torsoRZ * 0.025])
384:       addMesh(elbow, new THREE.SphereGeometry(thick * 1.18, 8, 6), darkMat, [0, -fore * 0.86, torsoRZ * 0.04])
385:       for (let c = -1; c <= 1; c++) {
386:         addMesh(elbow, new THREE.ConeGeometry(thick * 0.2, thick * 0.72, 4), clawMat,
387:           [c * thick * 0.54, -fore * 0.9, torsoRZ * 0.16], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0])
388:       }
389:       bodyGroup.add(arm)
390:       arms.push({ group: arm, side })
391:     }
392:   }
393: 
394:   // ── ground fit ──
395:   model.updateMatrixWorld(true)
396:   const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model)
397:   const lift = -box.min.y
398:   model.position.y = lift + 0.015
399: 
400:   // animation state
401:   let t = Math.random() * 10
402:   let walkAmt = 0
403:   let flashTime = 0
404:   let flashColor = new THREE.Color('#ffffff')
405:   const materials = []
406:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.material && !materials.includes(o.material)) materials.push(o.material) })
407:   const baseEmissive = materials.map(m => ({ m, e: m.emissive ? m.emissive.clone() : null, i: m.emissiveIntensity }))
408: 
409:   function update(dt, movement = 0) {
410:     t += dt
411:     walkAmt += (movement - walkAmt) * Math.min(1, dt * 7)
412:     const breathe = Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.014
413:     bodyGroup.scale.set(1 + breathe * 0.4, 1 + breathe, 1 + breathe * 0.3)
414:     bodyGroup.position.y = bodyY + Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.012 + Math.abs(Math.cos(t * 6)) * 0.03 * walkAmt
415:     neckBase.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.1) * 0.04 - 0.04 + walkAmt * 0.06
416:     headGroup.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.4 + 0.7) * 0.05
417:     headGroup.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.13
418:     headGroup.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.02
419: 
420:     tailSegs.forEach((seg, i) => {
421:       seg.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.4) * 0.12 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.05
422:       seg.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.2 + 0.6) * 0.035
423:     })
424:     for (let i = 0; i < wings.length; i++) {
425:       const side = i === 0 ? -1 : 1
426:       wings[i].rotation.z = side * (0.12 + Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 0.18) + side * walkAmt * 0.12
427:       wings[i].rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 0.06
428:     }
429:     for (const leg of legs) {
430:       const phase = walkAmt > 0.02 ? Math.sin(t * 7.5 + leg.phase) : 0
431:       leg.group.rotation.x = (leg.front ? 0.06 : -0.06) + phase * 0.5 * walkAmt
432:       leg.knee.rotation.x = Math.max(0, -phase) * 0.6 * walkAmt
433:     }
434:     for (const arm of arms) {
435:       arm.group.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 7.5 + (arm.side < 0 ? Math.PI : 0)) * 0.16 * walkAmt
436:     }
437:     if (flashTime > 0) {
438:       flashTime -= dt
439:       const k = Math.max(0, flashTime / 0.18)
440:       for (const b of baseEmissive) {
441:         if (!b.e) continue
442:         b.m.emissive.copy(b.e).lerp(flashColor, k)
443:         b.m.emissiveIntensity = b.i + k * 2.4
444:       }
445:     }
446:   }
447: 
448:   function flash(color = '#ffffff', duration = 0.18) {
449:     flashColor.set(color)
450:     flashTime = duration
451:   }
452: 
453:   function dispose() {
454:     model.traverse(o => {
455:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose()
456:     })
457:     for (const m of materials) m.dispose()
458:     root.removeFromParent()
459:   }
460: 
461:   root.userData = { update, flash, dispose, phenotype: p, materials }
462:   root.scale.setScalar(opts.scale ?? 1)
463:   root.name = 'creature'
464:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true } })
465:   return root
466: }
467: 
468: // ─── portrait snapshot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
469: let portraitRenderer = null
470: export function portraitDataURL(genome, size = 220) {
471:   if (!portraitRenderer) {
472:     portraitRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true })
473:     portraitRenderer.setPixelRatio(1)
474:     portraitRenderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
475:     portraitRenderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping
476:     portraitRenderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.1
477:     portraitRenderer.shadowMap.enabled = false
478:   }
479:   portraitRenderer.setSize(size, size, false)
480:   const scene = new THREE.Scene()
481:   const creature = buildCreature(genome)
482:   // face three-quarter
483:   creature.rotation.y = -0.5
484:   creature.update(0.2, 0)
485:   scene.add(creature)
486:   const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(creature)
487:   const sphere = box.getBoundingSphere(new THREE.Sphere())
488:   const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(34, 1, 0.1, 100)
489:   const dist = sphere.radius / Math.sin((34 * Math.PI / 180) / 2) * 0.84
490:   cam.position.set(sphere.center.x + dist * 0.18, sphere.center.y + dist * 0.18, sphere.center.z + dist)
491:   cam.lookAt(sphere.center)
492:   scene.add(cam)
493:   scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xcffcff, 0x203030, 2.2))
494:   const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3d6, 3.2)
495:   key.position.set(3, 5, 4)
496:   scene.add(key)
497:   const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x6fffd7, 2.2)
498:   rim.position.set(-4, 2, -3)
499:   scene.add(rim)
500:   portraitRenderer.render(scene, cam)
501:   const url = portraitRenderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86)
502:   creature.userData.dispose()
503:   return url
504: }

## Objective
- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts tied to creature discovery, genetics, breeding, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, saving and inspecting only the latest JPEG screenshot at a width of 1280px or less.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.
- Capture and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot, no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Add new selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for the new genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.

263: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
264:   const child = {}

266:   for (const gene of GENES) {
267:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
268:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
269:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
270:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
271:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
272:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
273:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
274:       mutations.push(gene.key)

276:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {

278:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
279:     }
280:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
281:   }

39:     ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rad, rad * (0.4 + r()), r() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
40:   }
41:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1
42: 
43:   const mode = Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.pattern * 4))
44:   ctx.fillStyle = p.darkColor
45:   if (mode === 0) {
46:     // High-contrast spots
47:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.48
48:     for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
49:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 3 + r() * 9
50:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rad * (0.7 + r() * 0.7), rad, r() * Math.PI, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
51:     }
52:   } else if (mode === 1) {
53:     // Flowing bands
54:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.42
55:     for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
56:       const y = i * 39 + 6 + r() * 10
57:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y)
58:       ctx.bezierCurveTo(70, y - 12, 170, y + 12, size, y - 4)
59:       ctx.lineTo(size, y + 12 + r() * 8)
60:       ctx.bezierCurveTo(170, y + 24, 70, y + 2, 0, y + 18)
61:       ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
62:     }
63:   } else if (mode === 2) {
64:     // Rosettes with a lighter center
65:     for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
66:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 5 + r() * 11
67:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.52
68:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
69:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.58
70:       ctx.fillStyle = p.accentColor
71:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, rad * 0.48, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
72:       ctx.fillStyle = p.darkColor
73:     }
74:   } else {
75:     // Fine dapple
76:     ctx.globalAlpha = 0.34
77:     for (let i = 0; i < 96; i++) {
78:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 2 + r() * 7
79:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill()
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   // Skin-specific surface detail makes hide alleles apparent on the model.
84:   ctx.globalAlpha = p.hide < 0.25 ? 0.28 : 0.38
85:   if (p.hide < 0.25) {
86:     // Velvet/fur: short directional fibers
87:     ctx.strokeStyle = p.accentColor; ctx.lineWidth = 1
88:     for (let i = 0; i < 700; i++) {
89:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, len = 2 + r() * 5
90:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + len * 0.35, y + len); ctx.stroke()
91:     }
92:   } else if (p.hide < 0.5) {
93:     // Scaled hide: overlapping scale arcs
94:     ctx.strokeStyle = p.darkColor; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4
95:     for (let y = -8; y < size + 12; y += 12) for (let x = -8 + ((y / 12) % 2) * 7; x < size + 12; x += 14) {
96:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0.15, Math.PI - 0.15); ctx.stroke()
97:     }
98:   } else if (p.hide < 0.75) {
99:     // Plated hide: angular overlapping scutes
100:     ctx.fillStyle = p.accentColor; ctx.strokeStyle = p.darkColor; ctx.lineWidth = 2
101:     for (let y = 0; y < size; y += 32) for (let x = (y % 64 ? 0 : 16); x < size; x += 32) {
102:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.24 + r() * 0.16
103:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 13, y + 3); ctx.lineTo(x + 16, y + 17); ctx.lineTo(x + 8, y + 23); ctx.lineTo(x, y + 17); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke()
104:     }
105:   } else {
106:     // Crystal hide: bright crystalline facets
107:     ctx.fillStyle = p.accentColor
108:     for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
109:       const x = r() * size, y = r() * size, rad = 4 + r() * 13
110:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22 + r() * 0.3
111:       ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y - rad); ctx.lineTo(x + rad * 0.65, y + rad * 0.35); ctx.lineTo(x, y + rad); ctx.lineTo(x - rad * 0.65, y + rad * 0.35); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill()
112:     }
113:   }
114:   ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18
115:   for (let i = 0; i < 800; i++) {
116:     ctx.fillStyle = r() > 0.5 ? '#ffffff' : '#000000'
117:     ctx.fillRect(r() * size, r() * size, 1, 1)
118:   }
119:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1
120:   const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas)
121:   tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
122:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping
123:   tex.anisotropy = 4
124:   texCache.set(cacheKey, tex)
125:   if (texCache.size > 100) {
126:     const first = texCache.keys().next().value
127:     texCache.get(first)?.dispose()
128:     texCache.delete(first)
129:   }
130:   return tex
131: }
132: 
133: function mat(color, opts = {}) {
134:   return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
135:     color,
136:     roughness: opts.roughness ?? 0.72,
137:     metalness: opts.metalness ?? 0.04,
138:     flatShading: opts.flat ?? false,
139:     emissive: opts.emissive ?? 0x000000,
140:     emissiveIntensity: opts.emissiveIntensity ?? 1,
141:     transparent: opts.transparent ?? false,
142:     opacity: opts.opacity ?? 1,
143:     side: opts.side ?? THREE.FrontSide,
144:     map: opts.map,
145:   })
146: }

148: function addMesh(parent, geo, material, pos = [0, 0, 0], rot = [0, 0, 0], scl = [1, 1, 1]) {
149:   const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material)
150:   m.position.set(...pos)
151:   m.rotation.set(...rot)
152:   m.scale.set(...scl)
153:   m.castShadow = true
154:   m.receiveShadow = true
155:   parent.add(m)
156:   return m
157: }
