159: // ─── creature mesh ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
160: export function buildCreature(genome, opts = {}) {
161:   const p = phenotype(genome)
162:   const root = new THREE.Group()
163:   const model = new THREE.Group()
164:   root.add(model)
165: 
166:   const s = 0.78 + p.size * 0.52
167:   const species = Math.min(3, Math.floor(p.archetype * 4))
168:   const biped = p.posture > 0.58
169:   const typeWidth = [1, 1.16, 0.78, 1.27][species]
170:   const typeLength = [1, 1.12, 0.86, 1.08][species]
171:   const torsoRY = (0.5 + p.girth * 0.3) * s * [1, 0.98, 0.82, 1.2][species]
172:   const torsoRX = (0.52 + p.girth * 0.48) * s * typeWidth
173:   const torsoRZ = (0.62 + p.length * 0.55) * s * typeLength
174:   const legLen = (0.34 + p.legs * 0.62) * s * [1, 0.9, 1.22, 0.82][species] * (biped ? 1.04 : 1)
175:   const legThick = (0.09 + p.stance * 0.12) * [1, 0.9, 0.78, 1.42][species]
176:   const hipY = legLen + torsoRY * 0.42
177:   const headScale = (0.34 + p.head * 0.36) * s * [1, 1.05, 0.88, 1.22][species]
178:   const bodyY = legLen + torsoRY * (biped ? 0.62 : 0.55)
179: 
180:   const coat = coatTexture(p, 'body')
181:   const bodyMat = mat(0xffffff, { map: coat, roughness: 0.66 })
182:   const darkMat = mat(p.darkColor, { roughness: 0.8 })
183:   const accentMat = mat(p.accentColor, { roughness: 0.55, metalness: 0.12 })
184:   const boneMat = mat('#e8dfc4', { roughness: 0.62, flat: true })
185:   const clawMat = mat('#332f27', { roughness: 0.4, metalness: 0.2 })
186:   const eyeMat = mat(p.eyeColor, { emissive: p.eyeColor, emissiveIntensity: 2.1, roughness: 0.2 })
187:   const pupilMat = mat('#0a0d0c', { roughness: 0.3 })
188:   const wingMat = mat(p.accentColor, { transparent: true, opacity: 0.72, side: THREE.DoubleSide, roughness: 0.5, emissive: p.darkColor, emissiveIntensity: 0.16 })
189: 
190:   const bodyGroup = new THREE.Group()
191:   bodyGroup.position.y = bodyY
192:   model.add(bodyGroup)
193: 
194:   const torsoGeo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2)
195:   const torsoTilt = biped ? -0.62 : 0
196:   const torso = addMesh(bodyGroup, torsoGeo, bodyMat, [0, 0, 0], [torsoTilt, 0, 0], [torsoRX, torsoRY, torsoRZ])
197:   // belly plate follows the body plan's torso angle.
198:   addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1), mat(p.accentColor, { roughness: 0.7 }), [0, -torsoRY * 0.55, torsoRZ * 0.05], [torsoTilt, 0, 0], [torsoRX * 0.8, torsoRY * 0.42, torsoRZ * 0.86])
199: 
200:   // ── neck & head ──
201:   const neckBase = new THREE.Group()
202:   neckBase.position.set(0, torsoRY * (biped ? 0.36 : 0.3), torsoRZ * 0.62)
203:   bodyGroup.add(neckBase)
204:   const neckLen = (0.16 + p.neck * 0.62) * s * [1, 1.34, 1.08, 0.76][species]
205:   const neckGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.17 * s, neckLen, 3, 8)
206:   addMesh(neckBase, neckGeo, bodyMat, [0, neckLen * 0.34, 0.06 * s], [-0.62 + p.neck * 0.2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1.05 + p.neck * 0.3])
207: 
208:   const headGroup = new THREE.Group()
209:   headGroup.position.set(0, neckLen * 0.82 + 0.06 * s, neckLen * 0.48)
210:   neckBase.add(headGroup)
211:   const skull = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2), bodyMat, [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [headScale, headScale * 0.82, headScale * 1.02])
212:   // jaw / snout
213:   const snoutLen = headScale * (0.72 + p.snout * 0.78)
214:   addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(headScale * 0.41, snoutLen, 3, 8), darkMat,
215:     [0, -headScale * 0.18, headScale * 0.62 + snoutLen * 0.34], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.8])
216:   addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(headScale * 0.3, snoutLen * 0.68, 3, 8), bodyMat,
217:     [0, -headScale * 0.38, headScale * 0.7 + snoutLen * 0.24], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.6])
218:   // teeth
219:   const toothGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.055, headScale * 0.19, 4)
220:   for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
221:     addMesh(headGroup, toothGeo, boneMat, [(i - 1.5) * headScale * 0.16, -headScale * 0.48, headScale * 0.72 + snoutLen * 0.4 + (i % 2) * 0.02], [Math.PI, 0, 0])
222:   }
223:   // eyes
224:   const eyeR = headScale * (0.13 + p.eyes * 0.1)
225:   for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
226:     const ex = side * headScale * 0.58, ey = headScale * 0.16, ez = headScale * 0.62
227:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.SphereGeometry(eyeR, 14, 10), eyeMat, [ex, ey, ez], [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.7])
228:     addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.SphereGeometry(eyeR * 0.48, 10, 8), pupilMat, [ex + side * eyeR * 0.35, ey, ez + eyeR * 0.5], [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 0.5])
229:   }
230:   // brow ridge
231:   addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.BoxGeometry(headScale * 0.95, headScale * 0.16, headScale * 0.34), darkMat, [0, headScale * 0.36, headScale * 0.5], [0.18, 0, 0])
232: 
233:   // horns
234:   const hornPairs = p.horns > 0.74 ? 3 : p.horns > 0.46 ? 2 : p.horns > 0.16 ? 1 : 0
235:   for (let pair = 0; pair < hornPairs; pair++) {
236:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
237:       const len = headScale * (0.55 + p.horns * 1.15) * (1 - pair * 0.22)
238:       const horn = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.14, len, 6), boneMat,
239:         [side * (headScale * 0.34 + pair * headScale * 0.12), headScale * 0.6 + pair * headScale * 0.15, headScale * (0.18 - pair * 0.24)],
240:         [-0.35, 0, side * -(0.25 + pair * 0.2)], [1, 1, 1])
241:       horn.castShadow = true
242:     }
243:   }
244:   // crest / ear fins
245:   if (p.wings > 0.3) {
246:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
247:       const fin = addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.26, headScale * 0.7, 4), wingMat,
248:         [side * headScale * 0.7, headScale * 0.15, -headScale * 0.15], [0, 0, side * -1.15], [1, 0.3, 1])
249:       fin.material = wingMat
250:     }
251:   }
252: 
253:   // ── back spikes ──
254:   if (p.armor > 0.2) {
255:     const count = 2 + Math.floor(p.armor * 7)
256:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
257:       const t = i / (count - 1 || 1)
258:       const h = torsoRY * (1.05 - t * 0.5) * (0.55 + p.armor * 0.55)
259:       const spike = addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(torsoRX * 0.16, h, 4), boneMat,
260:         [0, torsoRY * (0.72 - Math.abs(t - 0.4) * 0.5), torsoRZ * (0.62 - t * 1.25)],
261:         [-0.24, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1])
262:       spike.castShadow = true
263:     }
264:   }
265:   // shoulder scutes
266:   for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
267:     addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0), darkMat,
268:       [side * torsoRX * 0.72, torsoRY * 0.34, torsoRZ * 0.3], [0, 0, side * 0.4], [torsoRX * 0.26, torsoRY * 0.2, torsoRZ * 0.42])
269:   }
270:   // Species-specific silhouette details make the four archetypes readable at a glance.
271:   if (species === 1) { // Mireling: paired cheek/gill frills along a broad ribcage.
272:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
273:       addMesh(bodyGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(torsoRY * 0.16, torsoRY * 0.68, 5), accentMat,
274:         [side * torsoRX * 0.88, torsoRY * (0.28 - i * 0.08), torsoRZ * (0.42 - i * 0.48)],
275:         [0, 0, side * -1.05], [0.72, 1, 0.48])
276:     }
277:   } else if (species === 2) { // Skykin: swept feather crest, even when wing membranes are small.
278:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
279:       addMesh(headGroup, new THREE.ConeGeometry(headScale * 0.12, headScale * (0.52 + i * 0.12), 5), wingMat,
280:         [(i - 1) * headScale * 0.2, headScale * 0.68, -headScale * (0.12 + i * 0.12)],
281:         [-0.5, 0, (i - 1) * 0.16])
282:     }
283:   }
284: 
285:   // ── tail ──
286:   const tailSegs = []
287:   if (p.tail > 0.08) {
288:     let parent = new THREE.Group()
289:     parent.position.set(0, torsoRY * 0.12, -torsoRZ * 0.92)
290:     bodyGroup.add(parent)
291:     const segCount = 4
292:     for (let i = 0; i < segCount; i++) {
293:       const seg = new THREE.Group()
294:       const r = (0.2 - i * 0.032) * s * (0.7 + p.tail * 0.7) * [1, 0.88, 0.78, 1.32][species]
295:       const len = (0.32 + p.tail * 0.42) * s * [1, 1.22, 1.08, 0.82][species]
296:       seg.position.z = i === 0 ? 0 : -len * 0.92
297:       const g = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(Math.max(0.045, r), len, 2, 7)
298:       addMesh(seg, g, i % 2 === 0 ? bodyMat : darkMat, [0, 0, -len * 0.46], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0])
299:       parent.add(seg)
300:       tailSegs.push(seg)
301:       parent = seg
302:       if (i === segCount - 1 && p.armor > 0.3) {
303:         addMesh(seg, new THREE.ConeGeometry(r * 1.2, len * 1.1, 5), boneMat, [0, 0, -len * 1.1], [-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0])
304:       }
305:     }
306:   }
307: 
308:   // ── wings ──
309:   const wings = []
310:   if (p.wings > 0.42) {
311:     const wingGroup = new THREE.Group()
312:     wingGroup.position.set(0, torsoRY * 0.5, torsoRZ * 0.05)
313:     bodyGroup.add(wingGroup)
314:     const span = (0.9 + p.wings * 1.35) * s * [1, 0.92, 1.28, 1.05][species]
315:     const height = (0.6 + p.wings * 0.9) * s * [1, 0.94, 1.22, 1.08][species]
316:     const shape = new THREE.Shape()
317:     shape.moveTo(0, 0)
318:     shape.quadraticCurveTo(span * 0.55, height * 0.7, span, height * 0.18)
319:     shape.quadraticCurveTo(span * 0.7, -height * 0.12, span * 0.38, -height * 0.28)
320:     shape.quadraticCurveTo(span * 0.22, -height * 0.08, 0, 0)
321:     const wingGeo = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shape, 12)
322:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
323:       const pivot = new THREE.Group()
324:       pivot.rotation.z = side * 0.18
325:       wingGroup.add(pivot)
326:       const w = new THREE.Mesh(wingGeo, wingMat)
327:       w.scale.x = side
328:       w.castShadow = true
329:       pivot.add(w)
330:       // leading edge strut
331:       const bone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.028 * s, 0.045 * s, span, 5), darkMat)
332:       bone.position.set(side * span * 0.46, height * 0.22, 0)
333:       bone.rotation.z = side * -0.42
334:       bone.castShadow = true
335:       wingGroup.add(bone)
336:       wings.push(pivot)
337:     }
338:   }
339: 
340:   // ── legs & biped arms ──
341:   const legs = []
342:   const hips = biped
343:     ? [{ x: -1, z: -0.06, front: true }, { x: 1, z: -0.06, front: true }]
344:     : [
345:         { x: -1, z: 0.48, front: true }, { x: 1, z: 0.48, front: true },
346:         { x: -1, z: -0.5, front: false }, { x: 1, z: -0.5, front: false },
347:       ]
348:   for (const hip of hips) {
349:     const leg = new THREE.Group()
350:     leg.position.set(hip.x * torsoRX * (biped ? 0.43 : 0.62), hipY, hip.z * torsoRZ * (biped ? 0.48 : 0.86))
351:     const scaleLeg = (hip.front ? 0.86 : 1) * (0.8 + p.legs * 0.34) * (biped ? 1.14 : 1)
352:     const upper = legLen * 0.52 * scaleLeg
353:     const lower = legLen * 0.54 * scaleLeg
354:     const thick = legThick * (hip.front ? (biped ? 1.12 : 0.84) : 1.1)
355:     addMesh(leg, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick, upper, 2, 7), bodyMat, [0, -upper * 0.5, 0])
356:     const knee = new THREE.Group()
357:     knee.position.y = -upper
358:     leg.add(knee)
359:     addMesh(knee, new THREE.SphereGeometry(thick * 1.15, 8, 6), darkMat)
360:     addMesh(knee, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick * 0.78, lower * 0.82, 2, 7), darkMat, [0, -lower * 0.45, 0])
361:     const foot = addMesh(knee, new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(thick * 1.7, 1), darkMat, [0, -lower * 0.92, thick * 0.55], [0, 0, 0], [biped ? 1.2 : 1.5, 0.55, biped ? 1.45 : 1.9])
362:     foot.castShadow = true
363:     for (let c = -1; c <= 1; c++) {
364:       addMesh(knee, new THREE.ConeGeometry(thick * 0.3, thick * 1.15, 4), clawMat,
365:         [c * thick * 0.7, -lower * 0.94, thick * 1.4], [Math.PI / 2.2, 0, 0])
366:     }
367:     leg.rotation.x = hip.front ? 0.06 : -0.06
368:     legs.push({ group: leg, knee, front: hip.front, phase: hip.x > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI })
369:     model.add(leg)
370:   }
371:   const arms = []
372:   if (biped) {
373:     const armLen = legLen * 0.72
374:     for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
375:       const arm = new THREE.Group()
376:       arm.position.set(side * torsoRX * 0.72, torsoRY * 0.52, torsoRZ * 0.18)
377:       arm.rotation.z = side * 0.16
378:       const upper = armLen * 0.54, fore = armLen * 0.48, thick = legThick * 0.68
379:       addMesh(arm, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick, upper, 2, 7), bodyMat, [0, -upper * 0.42, 0])
380:       const elbow = new THREE.Group()
381:       elbow.position.y = -upper * 0.84
382:       arm.add(elbow)
383:       addMesh(elbow, new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(thick * 0.76, fore, 2, 7), darkMat, [0, -fore * 0.42, torsoRZ * 0.025])
384:       addMesh(elbow, new THREE.SphereGeometry(thick * 1.18, 8, 6), darkMat, [0, -fore * 0.86, torsoRZ * 0.04])
385:       for (let c = -1; c <= 1; c++) {
386:         addMesh(elbow, new THREE.ConeGeometry(thick * 0.2, thick * 0.72, 4), clawMat,
387:           [c * thick * 0.54, -fore * 0.9, torsoRZ * 0.16], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0])
388:       }
389:       bodyGroup.add(arm)
390:       arms.push({ group: arm, side })
391:     }
392:   }
393: 
394:   // ── ground fit ──
395:   model.updateMatrixWorld(true)
396:   const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model)
397:   const lift = -box.min.y
398:   model.position.y = lift + 0.015
399: 
400:   // animation state
401:   let t = Math.random() * 10
402:   let walkAmt = 0
403:   let flashTime = 0
404:   let flashColor = new THREE.Color('#ffffff')
405:   const materials = []
406:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.material && !materials.includes(o.material)) materials.push(o.material) })
407:   const baseEmissive = materials.map(m => ({ m, e: m.emissive ? m.emissive.clone() : null, i: m.emissiveIntensity }))
408: 
409:   function update(dt, movement = 0) {
410:     t += dt
411:     walkAmt += (movement - walkAmt) * Math.min(1, dt * 7)

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand Helix Forge — Creature Lab with animal-, fish-, and insect-inspired body parts integrated with creature discovery, genetics, breeding, and visuals.
- Build and verify the game, saving and inspecting only the latest JPEG screenshot at a width of 1280px or less.

## Requirements
- Modify the playable game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Preserve compatibility with existing saves and breeding.
- Capture and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot, no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Add selectable body-part traits as genes in `src/dna.js`.
- Treat missing alleles for new body-part genes as low expression for compatibility with older saves.
- Discovery will let the player choose body-part traits for a wild creature before it joins the sanctuary.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `ears`, `fins`, `gills`, `antennae`, `elytra`, and `extraLegs` gene definitions in `src/dna.js`, grouped as `adapt`.
- Added exported `allelesOf` defaults for absent or partial arrays: new body-part genes use `[0.04, 0.04]`; other genes use `[0.5, 0.5]`.
- Updated `phenotype`, `heterozygosity`, and `geneticSimilarity` to use `allelesOf`.

### Active
- Apply `allelesOf` consistently to `breedGenomes`, `dnaSequence`, and genome dossier rendering.
- Add procedural geometry for the new traits in `src/creature.js`.
- Implement discovery body-part selection and adaptation gene dossier display in `src/app.js` and `src/style.css`.
- Run `npm run build`, launch the game, capture a current JPEG screenshot at 1280px or less, and inspect only that latest screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update remaining missing-allele handling in `src/dna.js` and `src/app.js` to use `allelesOf`.
2. Add procedural geometry for ears, fins, gills, antennae, elytra, and extra legs.
3. Implement discovery body-part selection and adaptation gene dossier display.
4. Build and verify the game, then capture and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `src/dna.js`: Gene definitions, defaults, phenotype, stats, and inheritance.
- `src/creature.js`: Procedural 3D creature construction.
- `src/app.js`: Discovery flow, genome dossier, and game UI.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface styling.
- `package.json`: Build and development scripts.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `start.sh`: Game start script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed `M src/dna.js`.
- Discovery currently generates and immediately adds a wild creature; body-part choice is not implemented.
- No build or screenshot verification has been performed.

256: export function geneticSimilarity(a, b) {
257:   let sum = 0
258:   for (const gene of GENES) {
259:     const [a1, a2] = allelesOf(a, gene.key)
260:     const [b1, b2] = allelesOf(b, gene.key)
261:     const pa = (a1 + a2) / 2
262:     const pb = (b1 + b2) / 2
263:     sum += Math.abs(pa - pb)
264:   }
265:   return clamp01(1 - sum / GENES.length)
266: }

268: export function breedGenomes(genomeA, genomeB, mutationRate = 0.09) {
269:   const child = {}
270:   const mutations = []
271:   for (const gene of GENES) {
272:     const allelesA = genomeA[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
273:     const allelesB = genomeB[gene.key] || [0.5, 0.5]
274:     const pickA = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesA[0] : allelesA[1]
275:     const pickB = Math.random() < 0.5 ? allelesB[0] : allelesB[1]
276:     let a = pickA, b = pickB
277:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
278:       a = clamp(a + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
279:       mutations.push(gene.key)
280:     }
281:     if (Math.random() < mutationRate) {
282:       b = clamp(b + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.26)
283:       if (!mutations.includes(gene.key)) mutations.push(gene.key)
284:     }
285:     child[gene.key] = [a, b]
286:   }
287:   return { genome: child, mutations: [...new Set(mutations)] }
288: }

400:   // animation state
401:   let t = Math.random() * 10
402:   let walkAmt = 0
403:   let flashTime = 0
404:   let flashColor = new THREE.Color('#ffffff')
405:   const materials = []
406:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.material && !materials.includes(o.material)) materials.push(o.material) })
407:   const baseEmissive = materials.map(m => ({ m, e: m.emissive ? m.emissive.clone() : null, i: m.emissiveIntensity }))
408: 
409:   function update(dt, movement = 0) {
410:     t += dt
411:     walkAmt += (movement - walkAmt) * Math.min(1, dt * 7)
412:     const breathe = Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.014
413:     bodyGroup.scale.set(1 + breathe * 0.4, 1 + breathe, 1 + breathe * 0.3)
414:     bodyGroup.position.y = bodyY + Math.sin(t * 1.7) * 0.012 + Math.abs(Math.cos(t * 6)) * 0.03 * walkAmt
415:     neckBase.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.1) * 0.04 - 0.04 + walkAmt * 0.06
416:     headGroup.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.4 + 0.7) * 0.05
417:     headGroup.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.13
418:     headGroup.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.02
419: 
420:     tailSegs.forEach((seg, i) => {
421:       seg.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 0.4) * 0.12 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.05
422:       seg.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.2 + 0.6) * 0.035
423:     })
424:     for (let i = 0; i < wings.length; i++) {
425:       const side = i === 0 ? -1 : 1
426:       wings[i].rotation.z = side * (0.12 + Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 0.18) + side * walkAmt * 0.12
427:       wings[i].rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 0.06
428:     }
429:     for (const leg of legs) {
430:       const phase = walkAmt > 0.02 ? Math.sin(t * 7.5 + leg.phase) : 0
431:       leg.group.rotation.x = (leg.front ? 0.06 : -0.06) + phase * 0.5 * walkAmt
432:       leg.knee.rotation.x = Math.max(0, -phase) * 0.6 * walkAmt
433:     }
434:     for (const arm of arms) {
435:       arm.group.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 7.5 + (arm.side < 0 ? Math.PI : 0)) * 0.16 * walkAmt
436:     }
437:     if (flashTime > 0) {
438:       flashTime -= dt
439:       const k = Math.max(0, flashTime / 0.18)
440:       for (const b of baseEmissive) {
441:         if (!b.e) continue
442:         b.m.emissive.copy(b.e).lerp(flashColor, k)
443:         b.m.emissiveIntensity = b.i + k * 2.4
444:       }
445:     }
446:   }
447: 
448:   function flash(color = '#ffffff', duration = 0.18) {
449:     flashColor.set(color)
450:     flashTime = duration
451:   }
452: 
453:   function dispose() {
454:     model.traverse(o => {
455:       if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose()
456:     })
457:     for (const m of materials) m.dispose()
458:     root.removeFromParent()
459:   }
460: 
461:   root.userData = { update, flash, dispose, phenotype: p, materials }
462:   root.scale.setScalar(opts.scale ?? 1)
463:   root.name = 'creature'
464:   root.traverse(o => { if (o.isMesh) { o.castShadow = true; o.receiveShadow = true } })
465:   return root
466: }

468: // ─── portrait snapshot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
469: let portraitRenderer = null
470: export function portraitDataURL(genome, size = 220) {
471:   if (!portraitRenderer) {
472:     portraitRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true })
473:     portraitRenderer.setPixelRatio(1)
474:     portraitRenderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
475:     portraitRenderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping
476:     portraitRenderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.1
477:     portraitRenderer.shadowMap.enabled = false
478:   }
479:   portraitRenderer.setSize(size, size, false)
480:   const scene = new THREE.Scene()
481:   const creature = buildCreature(genome)
482:   // face three-quarter
483:   creature.rotation.y = -0.5
484:   creature.update(0.2, 0)
485:   scene.add(creature)
486:   const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(creature)
487:   const sphere = box.getBoundingSphere(new THREE.Sphere())
488:   const cam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(34, 1, 0.1, 100)
489:   const dist = sphere.radius / Math.sin((34 * Math.PI / 180) / 2) * 0.84
490:   cam.position.set(sphere.center.x + dist * 0.18, sphere.center.y + dist * 0.18, sphere.center.z + dist)
491:   cam.lookAt(sphere.center)
492:   scene.add(cam)
493:   scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xcffcff, 0x203030, 2.2))
494:   const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3d6, 3.2)
495:   key.position.set(3, 5, 4)
496:   scene.add(key)
497:   const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x6fffd7, 2.2)
498:   rim.position.set(-4, 2, -3)
499:   scene.add(rim)
500:   portraitRenderer.render(scene, cam)
501:   const url = portraitRenderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.86)
502:   creature.userData.dispose()
503:   return url
504: }
